The cat's tail is raised and curled at the tip. (2) The cat jumps onto a bed cluttered with dark blue and gray suitcases and white pillows. An older man with a receding hairline, wearing a red, white, and navy striped polo shirt, sits on the edge of the bed looking at the cat. (3) The man reaches out with his right hand, wearing a black smartwatch, to pet the cat's back. The cat settles down on a dark blue piece of clothing. Green floral patterns are visible on the bedsheet. (4) A close-up shot of the cat's face reveals green eyes and pink ears as it looks directly at the camera while lying down. A hand enters the frame from the right to pet the cat's head and ears. (5) The man is shown sitting and looking at his smartphone. The cat remains lying on the blue clothing next to him. Background reveals a warm, wood-paneled wall and indoor furniture.
